verdict_reason: The new type-page and roles helpers are clear and reused, but the add-address helper's default roles ignore the address type it is given.

todos.issue: addValidAddressToFreshOrganisation defaults roles to ['PLACE_OF_ORIGIN'] whatever addressType is passed (168-169). A caller that passes addressType: BRANCH or DESTINATION_CONSIGNEE_OR_IMPORTER without roles ticks a checkbox those forms do not offer, and the test stalls on a locator timeout rather than saving. Today every non-origin caller (add.fit.spec.js:270) happens to pass roles, so the default only works by accident.
todos.fix: Must: the default roles follow the chosen address type, so any address type the helper accepts saves without the caller naming roles. One way: default roles to [ROLES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE[addressType][0]] (from services/address-book), or require roles whenever addressType is passed.
